question: When two nuclei fuse together forming one nucleus during cell fusion, it is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**synkaryon**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **synkaryon** is the result of the fusion of two nuclei within a cell.
 
• During the process of cell fusion, the nuclei of the two cells combine to form a single nucleus called a synkaryon.
